They use common merchant silicon ASIC from vendors like Broadcom, Spectrum, and Barefoot Tofino. Unlike traditional switches, bare metal switches give customers the freedom to choose a network operating system that best fits their needs. By separating the hardware and software customers typically see significant CapEx and OpEx savings over traditional networking. You will also be able to innovate faster with a DevOps and community approach. There is typically a multitude of other benefits after a customer makes the initial investment to move to an open networking model. Connect with a Specialist What is a White Box Switch? A white-box switch is a network switch that is designed with merchant silicon and sold with open specifications, allowing it to be customized, programmed, and rebranded by the customer or third-party vendors. Unlike traditional switches, which are proprietary and locked down, white-box switches allow for greater flexibility and control in an enterprise network infrastructure. These software systems are designed to run on white box switches and offer greater flexibility, automation, scalability, and lower cost when compared to traditional proprietary vendors. The most popular popular Open-Source Open Network Operating System is the Software for SONiC , which is available as a free download. SONiC has become a popular choice for large organizations seeking an open ecosystem for their network infrastructure and as it matures, is becoming popular with organizations of sizes.
